machineChecked: node.style token references: TOKEN_UNKNOWN, TOKEN_RAW_COLOR, TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING, TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT, TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION (semantic_validate.py)
catalog == token files (extraction/build_token_catalog.py --check, run by verify_all.py)
policy category keys exist in token-catalog; propertyCategories == validator map (verify_all.py token-catalog)

overrides: PageSpec 2.0.0 adds an OPTIONAL closed node.style object {surface, text, accent, spacing, fontFamily, radius}. Every value must be a canonical token path from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json whose category fits the property (propertyCategories); colour roles must exist in page.theme. Raw colours, raw lengths and non-catalog fonts are rejected. Styling not expressed through node.style stays owned by the section contracts.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Never emit a raw hex/rgb; resolve through tokens.10-semantic.color-roles (all values exist in tailwind.config.js). No new colors.
rawValueRestrictions.gradient: Only the 3 section gradients and 6 modal gradients in tokens.00-foundation.gradient.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Only the closed motion patterns; no scroll-reveal (none exists on the original).
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: sm 640 / md 768 / lg 992 / xl 1280 / 2xl 1440 plus raw 960/961/639 queries for FAQ, table and blog scroller.
rawValueRestrictions.font-family: Only Cadiz cuts (by family, never by font-weight — see weightQuirk) and Recoleta 'serif'. Keep the unlayered h1/desktop-*/mobile-* rules unlayered.
rawValueRestrictions.type-scale: Only the measured scale steps in tokens.00-foundation.typography.scale (incl. the 2.0.0 article/blog steps); unlayered h1/desktop-*/mobile-* rules stay unlayered.
rawValueRestrictions.section-spacing: Per-section measured padding only (no spacing scale exists on the original).

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: value is not a key of token-catalog.tokens
rules.TOKEN_RAW_COLOR: hex / rgb() / rgba() / hsl() / oklch() / color() values
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: raw lengths (px, rem, em, %, vh, vw ...) or bare numbers
rules.TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION: token category does not fit the property, colour role missing from page.theme, or a token of another theme

themes.note: The only measured theme; no dark mode exists on the original or the clone.
